instruction: Exit the bathroom then go straight until you get to a room. Wait by the desk.

steps.thought: I'm in a bathroom facing a massage table. There appears to be a wooden door on the left side of the room, so I'll turn left to face it and find the exit.
I'm in a tiled bathroom with a massage table and sink. I need to find the exit; there's a dark doorway edge on the left side of my view, so I'll turn left to check it before moving.

I'm inside the bathroom facing its interior; the open doorway to the hallway is on my left (stone wall and rug visible beyond the door frame). I'll turn left to align with the exit before stepping through.

I've turned 120° left from the bathroom interior and now appear to be looking out through the doorway at a brick-walled area with a plant. I need to scan further left to find the open hallway and the desk, since no desk is visible yet.
I'm in the bathroom and can see the exit doorway ahead leading to a hallway and a room beyond. I'll align slightly left toward the doorway and move forward, then re-observe to find the desk.

I appear to have exited the bathroom (the blue-lit room with the tub is now behind/ahead through the open door) and I'm in a stone-walled hallway. There is a doorway on the left that may lead to the room with the desk, so I'll advance down the hall and then check the left opening.
I've exited the bathroom and am in a stone hallway. To my left there's an open doorway into a furnished room that could contain the desk. I'll turn toward it and inspect before entering.
I've exited the bathroom area and turned to face an open doorway leading into a room with what looks like a table/desk inside. I'll move forward through the doorway toward the desk.
I've passed through the doorway into a room containing a large table (the desk). I should advance toward it and stop nearby.
I'm currently inside a tiled bathroom/spa room with a massage table, robe, and sink. I need to find the exit doorway, so I'll turn to scan the room before moving.

I'm inside the bathroom/massage room and can see an open doorway ahead leading out to another room (with a lit pool area). I need to aim at that doorway and move forward to exit, then continue toward the desk.
I am in the bathroom facing an open doorway that leads out to another room. I will move forward through the doorway and then look for the desk in the next room.
I've exited the bathroom and am in a hallway facing an open doorway leading to another room (with a pool visible beyond). I should proceed straight through the doorway, then look for the desk.
I've exited the bathroom and am facing an open doorway leading into another room. The doorway is roughly centered ahead, so I'll advance through it and then look for the desk.

I've exited the bathroom and am at the doorway facing a large pool room. The instruction says to go straight into the room and wait by the desk; I can see a chair/desk area on the left side of the room ahead, so I'll advance through the doorway first.
I've exited the bathroom and entered a large pool/spa room. I can see a desk/counter with a chair on the left side of the room, so I'll turn left and approach it.

I have exited the bathroom into a large spa/pool room, and directly ahead on the left is a desk/counter with papers and a phone on it. I am already very close to it, so I will take one small step forward to be beside the desk and then stop.
